_comment: Relationship types for householding. Used by mc ContactProfile household section + future insurance/refi co-applicant flows. Lifted from refi-portal RELATIONSHIP_OPTIONS (refinance-v2-prototype.jsx:79-89) and reshaped from a flat string array into typed records ({id, label, category}) so packages/components/RelationshipPicker can carry both display + machine ids on a single source of truth. As of 2026-05-08-relationships-custom-split (Wave 20), the file splits canon-level `system_types` (immutable) from `custom_types_per_org` (super-admin-mutable, per-org overrides) — was W19 Task 5 _TODO.
_source: Lifted from refi-portal RELATIONSHIP_OPTIONS (refinance-v2-prototype.jsx:79-89). Refi's flat list: Spouse, Child, Parent, Sibling, Grandparent, Relative, Domestic Partner, Roommate, Other. Carried 1:1 here with id slugs + a `category` axis so future grouped UIs (household / extended / cohabitant / other) can stay declarative.
_consumers: blinker-platform/packages/components/RelationshipPicker.jsx (default options — reads system_types + merges org's custom_types_per_org[orgId] when org context is provided)
mission-control/src/personas/super/* (super-admin Manage Relationship Types UI — reads/writes custom_types_per_org via super-admin-storage.js shim until Phase 2 backend)
future: refi-portal co-applicant flow (retrofit ScreenCoAppContact to consume the picker — Wave 20 BL backlog)
_split_principle: system_types is the immutable canon-shipped seed; custom_types_per_org is super-admin-mutable per-org additions. Resolution: when displaying options for an org, RelationshipPicker computes the union as `[...system_types, ...(custom_types_per_org[orgId] || [])]`, dedupe-by-id (system wins on collision). Phase 1: custom_types_per_org persisted via mc super-admin-storage.js shim (key: blinker.super_admin.relationship_types_custom.v1) seeded from this canon file's empty default. Phase 2: replaced by `await blinkerApi.relationshipTypes.list({ org_id })` returning the merged shape.

_custom_type_shape.id: string — snake_case slug, must NOT collide with any system_types.id
_custom_type_shape.label: string — human display label
_custom_type_shape.category: string — one of household | extended | cohabitant | other (mirrors system axis); free-text allowed for future axes
_custom_type_shape.added_by: string? — user_id of the super-admin who created this entry
